description:
It’s time for an all-out V10 super-battle!

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-1609

We’ve gathered four iconic generations of raw ten-cylinder fury from the Volkswagen Group, and they’re going head-to-head to see which ultimate exhaust note reigns supreme! We’ve got an Audi R8 V10, a Lamborghini Huracán Performante, a classic Lamborghini Gallardo Performante, and a tuned Audi RS6 estate!

Can an absolute barging wagon beat lightweight supercar royalty off the line? Let’s check out the stats…

Starting with the Audi R8 V10, it’s powered by a 5.2-litre naturally aspirated V8-slayer, delivering 550hp and 540Nm of torque. Power goes to all four wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission with launch control, and it weighs in at 1,595kg. It’s an everyday supercar hero, and you can grab one today for an absolute bargain at £50,000!
